Name: Alliju's Plethora of Pterodactyls
Author: BottleOfSunshine
Description:
With the help of Alternative Textures, this mod adds pterodactyl textures for your dinos! Currently, there's 15 colors available, and I'm open for color suggestions as well!

﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿───────────────────────  ⋅ ∙ ∘ ☽ ༓ ☾ ∘ ⋅ ⋅  ─────────────────────
Download Instructions:

1. Download Alternative Textures
2. Unzip and drag the folder into your Mods folder
3. Download this mod
4. Unzip and drag the folder into your Mods folder
5. You're done!


To Change Texture:

1. Buy the "Scissors" from Robin (Typically 500g!)
2. Go up to your dinosaur and click on them with scissors in hand
3. Pick your ptero!

If you have more dinosaur textures, you can use the color you'd like (i.e. "Orange") or use the word "Pterodactyl" to narrow down the search!
Colors include: [color=#ff0000]Red[/color], [color=#ff00ff]Pink[/color], [color=#ff7700]Orange[/color], [color=#ffff00]Yellow[/color], [color=#00ff00]Green[/color], [color=#00ffff]Cyan[/color], [color=#1e84cc]Blue[/color], [color=#9900ff]Purple[/color], and [color=#a61c00]Brown[/color]!
